proof: For each actual closed obstacle mesh, minimize the Euclidean radius of its triangles after scalingXYZ by 1/radii around grasp. If normalized minimumd>1, obstacle surface is separated from analytic ellipsoid by at least min(radii)*(d-1). A disjoint-surface enclosed obstacle is excluded because its whole surface also hasradius>1; an obstacle enclosing the hand center is excluded by each meshAABB or hollow-bodyradiallocation. Negative signed normalizedmargin reports an actual surface point inside chosenproxy, not exact penetrationdepth.
hand_limit: Chosen analytic ellipsoid repeats prior illustrative dimensions. Handle4 intended contact is excluded; allotherstockparts,actualC reinforcedshells and all3Ccaptureassemblies included. No populationcoverage,knucklearticulation,gripforce orcomfortclaim.
